findings.title: Stale user liquidation auction can be filled for zero bid after 400 ledgers, transferring the lot for free
Lot scaled out during the ramp window is dropped from the auction and never delivered
Bad-debt transfer ignores the debtor's non-collateral supply, moving repayable debt onto the backstop
Self-fill of own user liquidation auction duplicates collateral
Pool initialize sets admin without admin authorization
findings.evidence: src/contract.rs:238 `fn initialize( e: Env, admin: Address,`

findings.title: Liquidation fill does not recheck the borrower's health, so a recovered account can be liquidated at stale terms
Oracle price of zero or negative is accepted and used in health checks
Per-second EPS rounding drops remainder of each gulp instead of carrying it
Auction block-age u32 subtraction underflows for fills in the creation ledger
Partial bad debt fill on a small backstop burns the remaining bid and bricks the auction
Soroban contract arithmetic can wrap around in release builds
Unpinned dependencies
Backstop client is generated from an unpinned local WASM path with no hash check
Emission index update drops an interval whose increment rounds to zero
First fillable ledger pays full bid for zero lot and deletes the auction
Emission share cap bypassed by u64 wrap in unchecked total_share accumulation
Auction fill percent narrowed from i128 to u64 without range check
Bad debt and interest auction fill amounts truncated from i128 to u64 without range check
Reserve with l_factor 0 makes every liability valuation panic
Interest auction sums duplicate asset entries, inflating value and the backstop-token bid
Interest auction becomes permanently unfillable after 400 ledgers, blocking all later interest auctions
Reserve timelock skipped for entries queued during Setup
User emission entries written without TTL extension
